summary: The candidate fails, though only one criterion is unmet. The prompt edits, the judge() enforcement with its tests, the 1,920 reader budget (measured at 1,916), the D93 record, the changelog entry and the 1,800 sweep are all correct. I ran the verify tests, the budgets test, fmt, clippy and the full test suite, and all passed. Criterion 10 fails, and it is one of the findings the user asked this retry to fix. Two lines rewritten in docs/design/decision-sets.md run far past the file's wrapping: line 108 is about 133 characters and line 114 about 160. Line 114 also adds "over the reader budget either way" to the dated review-1 measurement. To fix it, rewrap lines 108–114 of decision-sets.md to about 120 columns and drop "either way" so the review-1 paragraph gives only past figures.
